title: Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

reading.body:
A self-driving car operated by Avride struck and killed a duck in an Austin neighborhood while operating in autonomous mode with a human safety operator present. The vehicle did not slow down or stop before hitting the animal. This shows a perception or decision-making failure where the system either did not detect an obstacle in its path or did not recognize it as something requiring evasive action.

A human safety operator was in the vehicle but did not intervene to prevent the collision. What would have caught this failure before deployment is unclear from the reports, as it is not established what testing or simulation the system underwent to handle small animals on roadways, or what role the operator's attention level played in the incident.

A resident also alleged the vehicle failed to stop at a stop sign, but Avride disputed this claim after reviewing vehicle data. This allegation remains unresolved by independent verification.

summary:
# Summary

An autonomous vehicle operated by Avride struck and killed a mother duck in the Mueller Lake neighborhood of Austin, Texas, drawing significant community backlash. The incident occurred when the self-driving car, which had a human safety operator present, hit the duck without slowing down or stopping. The duck was particularly well-known to residents as it had been nesting near a local Italian restaurant. A resident reported the incident on a neighborhood Facebook group and also claimed the vehicle failed to stop at a stop sign, though Avride disputed this allegation after reviewing vehicle data.

In response to the controversy, Avride confirmed the vehicle was operating in autonomous mode during the incident and has adjusted its testing operations by excluding certain streets around the lake. The company is now evaluating technological improvements to prevent similar situations, including running simulated experiments to ensure safety remains unaffected. Meanwhile, local residents have preserved the duck's eggs in an incubator. Avride continues autonomous vehicle testing elsewhere in Austin, where multiple companies including Waymo, Tesla, and Zoox also operate.
